examples: packet reviewer instructions fixed to Claude/Anthropic

impact: Selecting DeepSeek could not produce a semantically correct DeepSeek-bound ReviewRequest/packet without bypassing or manually rewriting governed request semantics.
repair_scope: Derive selected reviewer provider/model_class from governed session state.
Make packet builder reviewer instructions/output contract provider-neutral and request-derived.

forbidden_shortcut: Do not merely replace the visible prompt text while leaving the governed ReviewRequest bound to Anthropic/Claude.
